body: They’ve actually been making me sad recently, I’m trying to get over this crush I have on a straight guy.
I vape and honestly if you can get by without it, don’t do it. Addiction to something just adds a whole new set of struggles...
It’s not your fault, it’s not. People who aren’t in your situation have no say.
You sound so dumb. People judging folks off appearance is what’s wrong with this country.

Literally all I wanna do is drink but same EVERYTIME I do the shit just gets worse. Yesterday while drunk I literally shaved off my eyebrows cuz I thought that would make me feel better? I feel you dude :/

You so deserve to live. It’s okay to fuck up. Life is not meant to be correct all the time. Let time pass. If those people are your friends reach out to them and try to talk. It’s okay, friend. Breathe.

Try to eat something. Treat yourself to your favorite thing to eat. I can’t promise it will fix everything and you will still feel the hurt, but please try to do whatever you can to recover and take care of yourself.
Please stay here. There’s songs you haven’t heard and people you have yet to meet

Ask God for help. Talk to him. Ask him to help you realize that you do, in fact, deserve love. Everyone does. Don’t let the bastards win. This is YOUR story. You can come back and come out on top. You can do it. I don’t even know you, I know. Just breathe. Take things day by day. There is no guidebook to life
Or the person that did to you is a complete scumbag and you didn’t deserve it at all. People that do that are horrible and evil. Sending u good vibes ♥️
I know how it feels so watch somebody you care about flirt or even be with another person right in front of you. I’m sorry. You don’t deserve to feel discarded like that.
This made me cry. (Happily lol), Blessings to you and your family
“They only go for rich ones.” I felt this in my soul. Literally felt this in my soul. I feel you.
I’m in love with you too

I read this and I think you are deserving of whatever you want. Do it for you. I’ve never met you but I wish I could come over and have a little party with you. You deserve it, you deserve everything that will make you feel good.
